> Here is the Paris 2019 EC drawing contest.
> What we want is you to create what best illustrates the European Championship of VTES in Paris. You are absolutely free for your inspiration, whether you go large with Vampires in Paris, or more narrow on the theme of our favorite card game.
> The winning design will be printed on the t-shirts created for the EC in Paris and the designer will be offered his registration to the EC with all the goodies, including a t-shirt with his own drawing.
> If the winner does not come to the EC, he'll be offered all the goodies he would have had if he had come.
> You can upload your drawings on the Facebook page www.facebook.com/ParisVtes, the Twitter account twitter.com/ParisVtes or by email  before Sunday, January 13, 2019 23h59.
>
Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
